indication.text: Treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who are anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) antibody positive.

citations.quote: IMAAVY is indicated for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who are anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) antibody positive.

target_moa.text: Nipocalimab binds to the IgG binding site on the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) at both neutral and acidic pH to inhibit IgG recycling, reducing circulating IgG levels including pathogenic IgG (anti-AChR and anti-MuSK autoantibodies).

citations.quote: Nipocalimab binds to the IgG binding site on FcRn at both neutral and acidic pH to inhibit IgG recycling, resulting in the reduction of circulating IgG levels including those of pathogenic IgG

modality.text: mAb (human aglycosylated IgG1 lambda monoclonal antibody / FcRn blocker)

citations.quote: Nipocalimab is a human, aglycosylated IgG1\lambda monoclonal antibody

requirement.text: 4833-1 Conduct a worldwide descriptive study that collects prospective and retrospective data in women exposed to lmaavy (nipocalimab) during pregnancy and lactation to assess risk of pregnancy and maternal complications, adverse effects on the developing fetus and neonate, and adverse effects on the infant. Infant outcomes will be assessed through at least the first year of life. The minimum number of patients will be specified in the protocol. The protocol must be agreed upon with the Agency.
